title: Diseño de Progresión de Personaje Caballero Fantástico: 4 Etapas de Evolución de Novato a Legendario
prompt: Game design illustration. Create beginner, intermediate, advanced, and elite versions of a fantasy knight character, each with a distinct appearance, and arrange them in order. The character names are: Novice Knight, Veteran Knight, Master Knight, Legendary Knight.
